# CredentialOAuthTool

The coding agent whose subscription an OAuth credential signs in to.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Claude"` | Claude Code, on an Anthropic (Claude Pro or Max) subscription. |
| `"Codex"` | Codex, on an OpenAI (ChatGPT) subscription. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CredentialSignInStart`](credential-sign-in-start.md)
- Inside [`CredentialSignInTokensRequest`](credential-sign-in-tokens-request.md)
- Inside [`ModelCredentialOAuth`](model-credential-o-auth.md)
